system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Records that a vaccination has been administered by authorized personnel. For your information, my booking_id is None, my livestock_id is None, my administered_date is dummy_administered_date_6442.

function.name: livestock_record_vaccination
function.description: Records that a vaccination has been administered by authorized personnel. Transitions vaccination_status to 'administered'. Vaccination must be in 'scheduled' status and service must be 'assigned' or 'completed'. Requires session_token. Farmers CANNOT self-administer via this system. Does NOT generate certificates. Fails if vaccination is not scheduled, unauthorized personnel attempt recording, or duplicate record exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

vaccine_batch_number.description: Batch number of the vaccine administered.
